# Architecture Blueprint & Guidelines

## Core Blueprint
- Framework: Next.js 16+
- React: 19.2+
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (OKLCH Light Mode)
- Typography: Swiss Modernist

## Transformation Strategy
All existing routes will be expanded with in-depth institutional content (>800 words), incorporating calculators, filters, and Bento-Grid interactions without creating any new routes or altering the existing path structure.

Refer to `.jules/revolution-plan.json` and `.jules/architecture-matrix.md` for specific transformation targets.
